source.title: Bald Eagle Calls / Chirps
source.author: Kinoton
source.notes: 48 kHz mono, 18 s: two bald eagles' chittering calls (1.3-4.5 kHz), already isolated, with a short reverb, 53-55 dB over the background. Four phrases: two loud chitters, a run of softer calls and a short series. A real bald eagle chitters; the scream films give eagles is a red-tailed hawk's. A high shelf (-10 dB above 2 kHz) eases the chitter's peaks at 2.5-3 and 4-5 kHz, the ear's most sensitive range, which were painful to the author.
